answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that flows like a river: it can only move downstream toward verified work, never sideways to fresh identities. A public mirror ledger records each agent's stake, attestations, and slashing history, so a Sybil swarm cannot hide behind new faces - its cost is visible to all. Like an ocean, the shared reward pool dilutes any single fake identity's influence, because payouts are divided by total staked reputation, making mass identity creation economically pointless.
